zero_obligation_gate.rationale: Actual backend Create/Put/Update/CompareAndSwap/Get calls complete through the real Firestore Go client and local gRPC test server. Non-UTF-8 binary values roundtrip as protobuf BytesValue, CAS mismatch leaves the value unchanged, and legacy string records return correct bytes with ID/expiry intact. Test defers cancel the bounded context and close the native client/connection/listener and stop the gRPC server on return; both Go test processes finish. Code/tests are the requested durable result. No cloud Firestore account, real OTP enrollment or external authentication is activated; no concrete task completion action remains.

task_execution_gate.rationale: The actual baseline record.Value and write paths cast arbitrary bytes to string. The patch uses []byte writes, bytes.Equal for CAS and a shared legacy-string fallback across reads. A native integration test uses the actual Firestore client on a loopback gRPC implementation, checks protobuf BytesValue and equality for four non-UTF8 payloads through Create/Put/Update/CAS/Get plus mismatch rejection, and retrieves a legacy record with its ID/expiry. The focused test and complete firestore package invocation pass offline. This does not claim a real cloud write or executed watch/GetRange/KeepAlive operations; those read paths are statically routed through the same decoder and compile. Source/test payload text matches frozen files after CRLF normalization. Source matches the published user content, allowing only one file-ending newline. All actual core hashes match the provider-format freeze, raw/published roles/content and guard messages match, and all tool return codes are zero. Editorial projection is historical pre-provider-format metadata; semantic_status, result and freeze bind final actual hashes. No peer review, Guard result, GT or reference/history answer was read.
